how.intro: A quick guide to the Daqui features you'll use most often.

0.title: My neighborhood and Near me
0.desc: At the top of Home, choose your saved neighborhood or the one nearest your location. You can also include nearby areas and filter by category.

1.title: The Resident badge
1.desc: Posts and comments by people who live in the neighborhood receive the Resident badge, distinguishing neighbors from visitors.

2.title: Post in seconds
2.desc: Tap New post, choose a category, add media, or create a poll. Reserve the important marker for urgent matters.

3.title: Like, comment, and share
3.desc: Interact with neighborhood posts and forward useful ones to a conversation or group.

4.title: Direct messages and groups
4.desc: Talk privately with a neighbor or join topic-based groups from the Messages and Groups tabs.

5.title: Neighborhood map
5.desc: See nearby notices and events on the map.

6.title: Report inappropriate content
6.desc: Use Report on posts, comments, or profiles to notify the moderation team.

7.title: Rate Daqui
7.desc: Tell us about your experience through Rate Daqui in the sidebar.

0.a: A neighborhood social network for sharing notices and recommendations, organizing events, and helping neighbors.

1.q: How does the app know my neighborhood? Can I change it?
1.a: Your neighborhood comes from your profile and can be updated under Settings > My address. Near me uses your current location without changing your profile.

2.q: What's the difference between My neighborhood, Near me, and Include nearby areas?
2.a: My neighborhood uses your profile; Near me uses your current location; Include nearby areas also shows neighboring communities.

3.q: What does the Resident badge mean?
3.a: It indicates that the author lives in the neighborhood where the post or comment was made.

4.q: Who can see what I post?
4.a: Anyone viewing the neighborhood feed can see posts and comments. Your exact address is never displayed.

5.q: What happens when I mark a post as important?
5.a: It receives priority in the feed. Use this only for genuinely urgent notices.

6.a: The moderation team reviews each report and decides whether to remove the content.

7.a: Yes. Rule violations may result in a temporary or indefinite suspension.

8.q: Is Daqui responsible for sales between neighbors?
8.a: No. Daqui does not handle payments, delivery, or guarantees.

9.q: How do I recover access to my account?
9.a: Open a support ticket describing the problem.

10.q: How do I delete my account and data?
10.a: Open a ticket requesting deletion and support will guide the process.

11.q: What's the difference between a report and a support ticket?
11.a: Reports concern content or profiles; tickets are for questions, technical problems, and account requests.

12.q: How long does a response take?
12.a: There is no fixed timeframe. The response will appear under My tickets.

13.a: Yes. Posting, commenting, messaging, and joining groups are free.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what data Daqui collects, why it is used, and your rights under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law No. 13,709/2018).

0.text: The people responsible for Daqui are the controllers of data processed in the app. To exercise your rights or ask privacy questions, open a ticket under Help & support or contact franciscogardenberg@gmail.com.
Registration data:

items.2: Other information you choose to add.

items.1: Used to identify the nearest neighborhood for Near me;
items.2: Used to position notices on the map;

items.0: Login sessions, including device, browser, IP address, and access date and time;

0.text: We process data to perform the app-use agreement, for Daqui's and the community's legitimate interests in moderation, security, and fraud prevention, and, where applicable, with your consent, such as when you authorize device location or push notifications.

items.0: Notification infrastructure providers, including Expo Push Service, to deliver device notifications;
items.1: Geocoding services, including OpenStreetMap and Nominatim, to convert coordinates into a neighborhood or address without identifying you to those services;

items.3: Other users, only for information inherently public in the app, such as name, username, photo, neighborhood, posts, and visible comments. If you link your account to your own ad, the same public information also appears on the ad card.
